parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL IDs (aliased as compound_chembl_id) and canonical SMILES for compounds with activity records against target CHEMBL203 where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Join activities to assays on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
